programs.codeql:
#!/bin/sh
place='<place>'
if [ -f "$place/fake/codeql.count" ]; then count=$(/bin/cat "$place/fake/codeql.count"); else count=0; fi
count=$((count + 1))
printf '%s\n' "$count" > "$place/fake/codeql.count"
out=
for argument in "$@"; do
  case "$argument" in --output=*) out="${argument#--output=}" ;; esac
done
case "$1 $2" in
  'database create'|'database init'|'database trace-command'|'database finalize') step="$2-$(/usr/bin/basename "$3")" ;;
  'database analyze') step="analyze-$(/usr/bin/basename "$out" .sarif)" ;;
  'query run') step=query ;;
  'bqrs decode') step=decode ;;
  *) step="$1" ;;
esac
{
  printf 'call %s %s\n' "$count" "$step"
  printf 'cwd %s\n' "$(pwd -P)"
  for argument in "$@"; do printf 'argument %s\n' "$argument"; done
  printf 'OPENSSL_DIR %s\n' "${OPENSSL_DIR-<unset>}"
  printf 'CODEQL_BUILD_JOBS %s\n' "${CODEQL_BUILD_JOBS-<unset>}"
  printf 'JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS %s\n' "${JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS-<unset>}"
  printf 'TMPDIR %s\n' "${TMPDIR-<unset>}"
  printf 'HOME %s\n' "${HOME-<unset>}"
} >> "$place/fake/codeql.log"
answer="$place/fake/codeql/$step"
if [ -f "$answer.sh" ]; then . "$answer.sh"; fi
if [ -f "$answer.stdout" ]; then /bin/cat "$answer.stdout"; fi
if [ -f "$answer.status" ]; then exit "$(/bin/cat "$answer.status")"; fi
exit 0
programs.helper:
#!/bin/sh
place='<place>'
case "$1" in
  codeql) kind=policy; shift 2 ;;
  vendor) kind=vendor; shift 1 ;;
  */build/*_triage.py) kind=policy; shift 1 ;;
  */build/security_vendor.py) kind=vendor; shift 1 ;;
  *) kind=other ;;
esac
out=
previous=
for argument in "$@"; do
  if [ "$previous" = --output ]; then out="$argument"; fi
  previous="$argument"
done
if [ "$kind" = policy ]; then step="policy-$(/usr/bin/basename "$out")"; else step="$kind"; fi
{
  printf 'call %s\n' "$step"
  printf 'cwd %s\n' "$(pwd -P)"
  for argument in "$@"; do printf 'argument %s\n' "$argument"; done
} >> "$place/fake/helper.log"
answer="$place/fake/helper/$step"
if [ -f "$answer.sh" ]; then
  . "$answer.sh"
elif [ "$kind" = policy ]; then
  /bin/mkdir -p "$out" && printf '{"passed": true}\n' > "$out/report.json"
fi
if [ -f "$answer.status" ]; then exit "$(/bin/cat "$answer.status")"; fi
exit 0
programs.cache:
#!/bin/sh
place='<place>'
operation="$2"
database=
previous=
for argument in "$@"; do
  if [ "$previous" = --database ]; then database="$argument"; fi
  previous="$argument"
done
if [ -f "$place/fake/cache.$operation.count" ]; then count=$(/bin/cat "$place/fake/cache.$operation.count"); else count=0; fi
count=$((count + 1))
printf '%s\n' "$count" > "$place/fake/cache.$operation.count"
{
  printf 'call %s %s\n' "$operation" "$count"
  for argument in "$@"; do printf 'argument %s\n' "$argument"; done
} >> "$place/fake/cache.log"
answer="$place/fake/cache/$operation.$count"
if [ -f "$answer.sh" ]; then . "$answer.sh"; fi
if [ -f "$answer.stdout" ]; then /bin/cat "$answer.stdout"; fi
if [ -f "$answer.status" ]; then exit "$(/bin/cat "$answer.status")"; fi
exit 0
